statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON (green). Tail remains well below the block threshold while Stress stays elevated on the concentrated 14:00Z catalyst stack.
recommendation: Conditions are described as contained and two-way roughly one hour before the U.S. cash open. The narrow danger window spans 13:30Z-15:30Z, covering the open, Chicago PMI, the Warsh keynote and the delayed second leg that would follow a rates-first repricing. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain active throughout.
headline: NQ still holds the same unchanged overnight range into the U.S. open, with the 14:00Z Warsh keynote and payroll benchmark revision as the decisive checkpoints
body: The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed Thursday at 29,641.56, up 1.43% and effectively at the session high of 29,643.53, after Nvidia rose 8.74% on record quarterly revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year. Into the U.S. pre-market NQ futures trade near 29,639, about 0.19% below the 29,695.75 previous close, and remain inside the identical 29,578.25-29,707.00 range that has framed the whole session: the range has not widened for hours, price has retraced from the low back toward the middle of it, and no new extreme has been set. That is two-way structure rather than the persistent no-retracement path that Tail measures, so Tail is held at 11. Cross-assets give no confirming stress. VIX is 14.44, down 0.48%, inside a 14.44-14.58 day range; WTI is near $82.71 and Brent near $87.74, both roughly 1% lower as reporting points to easing supply risk on prospects for a Strait of Hormuz arrangement; Treasury yields are little changed with 2Y and 10Y constant maturities last published at 4.19% and 4.66%. Index futures show rotation rather than broad de-risking, with the Dow contract about 0.15% higher and the S&P 500 contract flat against NQ's 0.19% decline, while gold is 0.29% lower. Breadth is the one genuine conflict: only 156 of 503 S&P 500 members advanced in Thursday's rally, and Marvell fell more than 7% after hours despite beating on revenue and guidance, which keeps semiconductors the main index swing factor. Stress is raised to 55 for the concentrated 14:00Z stack, where Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote as Fed Chair, the BLS preliminary benchmark revision to nonfarm payroll employment and the final August Michigan survey all land in the same hour, preceded by Chicago PMI at 13:45Z. Reporting notes that Warsh has rejected explicit forward guidance, that Kansas City Fed President Schmid called inflation too hot this week, and that roughly a third of bond traders price a September hike, which widens the distribution of plausible tones. Consistent with the calibration that a large surprise is not by itself a lethal price path, that dispersion raises Stress and caps Confidence rather than raising Tail; a rates-first repricing with a delayed equity second leg remains the credible conditional escalation mechanism and is carried in the 14:00Z and 15:00Z forecast hours rather than in the current score. Confidence is 88 on current verified levels, yields, oil, volatility and a verified calendar.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the assessment stayed in the EA_ON state with Tail between 10 and 14 and Stress between 46 and 54. Two hours late in Thursday's U.S. session were scored trend-up as the Nvidia-driven advance carried the index to a close at 29,641.56 near the day's high. Overnight and through the European morning the mode reverted to mixed as futures gave back part of that move inside a contained range that never widened, with Stress drifting from the mid-40s to the mid-50s as the Jackson Hole catalyst stack approached. One hour, 10:00Z on 28 August, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The horizon splits into three phases. The current 12:00Z hour is the last quiet one: the base case is continued two-way trade inside the unchanged overnight range while pre-event positioning builds. From 13:00Z to 15:00Z the U.S. cash open, Chicago PMI at 13:45Z and the 14:00Z keynote stack form the highest-risk stretch, peaking at the 14:00Z and 15:00Z hours where the mapped policy state is WATCH; a delayed rates-first second leg is carried as a real conditional path rather than an observed one. From 16:00Z conditional risk decays on the assumption that price discovery is orderly and retracements return, with a small step up into the 20:00Z power hour for pre-weekend squaring. CME equity index futures settle at 21:00Z, so the final fifteen hours are closed-market placeholders in which weekend gap exposure accumulates toward the Sunday 22:00Z reopen.
